instruction:
Write a Dockerfile for a Rust 1.78 application.
- Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock are present
- src/main.rs is the entry point
- Port 8080
output:
FROM rust:1.78
WORKDIR /app
COPY Cargo.toml Cargo.lock ./
COPY src ./src
RUN cargo build --release
EXPOSE 8080
CMD ["./target/release/app"]

instruction:
Write a Dockerfile for a Rust app using musl for fully static linking.
- Port 8080
output:
FROM rust:1.78 as builder
RUN rustup target add x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
WORKDIR /app
COPY Cargo.toml Cargo.lock ./
COPY src ./src
RUN cargo build --release --target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl

FROM scratch
COPY --from=builder /app/target/x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/release/app /app
EXPOSE 8080
CMD ["/app"]

instruction:
Write a Dockerfile for a Rust 1.78 WASM app compiled with wasm-pack.
- Build stage compiles to WASM
- Final stage serves with a static server
- Port 8080
output:
FROM rust:1.78 as builder
RUN rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown
RUN cargo install wasm-pack
WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
RUN wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir pkg

FROM nginx:alpine
COPY --from=builder /app/pkg /usr/share/nginx/html/pkg
COPY index.html /usr/share/nginx/html/index.html
EXPOSE 8080
CMD ["nginx", "-g", "daemon off;"]
